rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a micro-uptrend that just reversed on elevated volume (25,854 on the final bar closing lower), suggesting short-term momentum is stalling near $69.11–$69.23 with no clear directional conviction. Price is below VWAP ($69.51) and below the 9-EMA ($69.21), which slightly favors the short side, but the strong earnings beat (reported ~8 hours ago) and broad market tailwind (SPY +0.52%, VIXY -0.85%) create meaningful upside risk for any short. With 72 minutes to close, the range is wide (ATR ~$0.30 on 5m bars but today's full range is $6+), the setup lacks a clean structural level to anchor a stop, and the conflicting signals do not offer sufficient edge to justify capital commitment.
